intro.text: The deputy scribe of immigration on duty at Hauka's post in Yeddaw, Tashikk, the day Lift reaches the city.

items.text: He and Hauka checked the papers of an oddly well-dressed farmer and decided he was smuggling grain raided in Emul. Nissiqqan suggested a triple tariff, with the money going to feed refugees.
Lift suddenly appeared and brushed past him while dodging Hauka, and he dropped his folders.

appearance.text: An older man with a furrowed face and a cleft chin, wearing glasses and a yellow shiqua and carrying folders of forms. He likes being out in the sun.

personality.text: He knows local taxes and ordinances well but will overlook petty crimes if fair reparations are paid, and he cares about refugees.
